facts.title: Corsair UI · React components for shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS
facts.description: Open-source React components, motion effects and page blocks for shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS 3.4 and 4. Accessible, built on Radix, installed as source code with the shadcn CLI.

research.name: Corsair UI
research.note: shadcn registry of Radix-based React components, motion effects and page blocks, shown through a nautical-themed site.
unverified: The source is in the public repository KevinGirelli/corsair-ui (MIT); research that repository instead.

The compass and voyage theme belongs to the landing page; the components seen (button, input, badge, card, form fields) are ordinary shadcn-style pieces, so genericCollection is a judgement from the homepage only.
